verdict: About 30% done. The groundwork is proven, the main window and every shared control are built and approved, and about half the backend has moved into the shared crate. Timeline, Chat and the frame-preview move are running now; the recording engine is next.

now.title: Frame previews move
now.detail: The preview pipeline (scrub previews, frame images, cache) moves to the shared crate behind a small file-permission signal the GPUI app ignores.

now.title: Timeline screen
now.detail: Frame stage, OCR and match overlays, the scrub rail with app bands, the date jumper, the scrub engine with every timing constant tested, image cache, frame-time measurement.

now.title: Chat screen
now.detail: Conversation list, thread, live-streaming answers (bars, dossier, timeline blocks), sources, composer, model picker; streaming frame-time measurement.

done.title: Plan, agents, skill, hooks
done.what: The slice plan, four specialised agents, a conventions skill every agent loads, and hooks that format code and enforce the 800-line cap.

done.title: Side-by-side screenshot tool
done.what: One command shoots GPUI | Tauri | mockup for any screen and state, so every gap is visible.

done.title: Spike: proved the stack
done.what: All 11 risky pieces work in GPUI: fonts, transparent titlebar, Quick Recall-style panel, hidden from screen capture, tray, global hotkey, mnema:// links, database on tokio, graceful ⌘Q, offscreen golden screenshots. First paint ~160 ms; 0% CPU when hidden.

done.title: Toolchain pinned to 1.99.1
done.what: GPUI needs Rust ≥1.93; the repo now pins stable so local builds match CI.

done.title: Shared backend crate
done.what: app-core: the seam both apps run on (host, paths, events, one runtime, typed state). The Tauri app runs on it unchanged.

done.title: First backend moves
done.what: Logging, recording settings, model-download lock, and 7 self-contained modules (clock format, speaker helper, OCR budget, …).

done.title: GPUI main window
done.what: Titlebar, status bar, themes with system follow and cross-fade, keyboard shortcuts, notifications / shortcuts / status popovers. 33 behaviour tests.

done.title: More backend moves
done.what: ChatGPT login, app log, storage, debug status, licensing, licence-list refresh, shortcut model. Fixed a regression where ‘open app log’ lost its error message.

done.title: Model downloads + semantic search
done.what: OCR, transcription and speaker model downloads, the download lock, semantic search models, worker and query (SQL byte-identical).

done.title: Update install gate
done.what: An update installs only if Apple-signed by your own team with the same bundle id (and the CLI helper too). Caught and fixed a forgeable team check before it landed.

done.title: Shared controls
done.what: Every control the app uses, themed to the redesign: buttons, segmented, switch, inputs, selects, date picker, popovers, tooltips, toasts, modals, notices, skeletons, chips.

done.title: Updater core
done.what: Update settings, status machine and the licence update-window gate moved to the shared crate.

done.title: AI runtime + user context
done.what: AI provider resolution (incl. the ChatGPT token-refresh gate, unchanged), user context, privacy rules, sensitive-app recommendations.

done.title: Database layer
done.what: Setup, workers' control, the frame pipeline, timeline/search/speaker commands, retention policy, Quick Recall's backend, CLI access and the CLI approval channel — 50 SQL strings unchanged, 1,356 tests green.

next.title: Move the recording engine + Ask AI
next.detail: The riskiest step: ~48k lines, in seven ordered steps, each keeping both apps building. Needs a real recording smoke test on a copy of your data.

next.title: Startup and shutdown
next.detail: One shared start/stop sequence, identical log lines in both apps.

next.title: Native layer
next.detail: Tray menu, global hotkeys, mnema:// links, single instance, Dock, graceful quit, reminder notification. Needs one signed-build check from you.

next.title: The remaining screens
next.detail: Settings, Insights, Quick Recall, small windows, audio drawer, onboarding: three at a time, each with screenshots for your sign-off.

next.title: Packaging + updater
next.detail: Bundle script, signing, notarisation, download → verify → replace → relaunch.

next.title: Cut-over
next.detail: On your go: GPUI becomes Mnema, Tauri and Svelte are deleted.

rulings: Side by side, not a rewrite in place; Tauri keeps shipping until cut-over.
Solid tinted surfaces instead of in-window blur (titlebar, popovers).
The titlebar section icons may stay the app's own drawings.
12 shell and 20 control screenshots approved after viewing.
risks: Disk space: three parallel builds share ~25–30 GB free; it has filled twice. More free space = more agents at once.
The recording-engine move (S3) is the riskiest step; permission flows need your signed build.
Screens may need several fix rounds to match pixel-for-pixel; the Timeline will show how many.
